crossRefs.note: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank…

translations.web: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.
translations.bsb: His father-in-law, the girl’s father, persuaded him to stay, so he remained with him three days, eating, drinking, and lodging there.
translations.kjv: And his father in law, the damsel's father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged
translations.asv: And his father-in-law, the damsel's father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.
